title: MENA CI English Lesson: Expressing Conditions
summary: This lesson helps students understand and use conditional sentences in English to discuss school performance and future actions. It covers vocabulary related to academic results, grammar structures for expressing conditions, and practical activities to reinforce learning.
lesson:
# Lesson: Expressing Conditions in English

## 1. Learning Context
You are a student in the second term of the year. Your English marks are not great, and you meet a top Ghanaian classmate who offers advice on improving your results.

## 2. Language Function
**Expressing conditions** – using *if* and *unless* to talk about future possibilities.

### 2.1 Grammar Structures
- **If + present simple → will + base verb** (future result)
  - *If Koffi works harder, he will improve his school results.*
- **Unless + present simple → will + base verb** (negative condition)
  - *You will fail this year unless you catch up.*

### 2.2 Vocabulary (School Results)
| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| work harder | study with more intensity |
| go up | advance to a higher grade |
| stay down | remain in the same or lower grade |
| obtain good results | achieve high marks |
| improve school results | raise your grades |
| pass the BEPC exam | succeed in the BEPC test |
| fail | not succeed |
| catch up | make up for lost learning |
| aim | objective |
| grade | mark |

## 3. Practice Activities
### Activity 1 – Fill in the gaps
Use the words: *study, go up, improve, fail, harder, marks, obtain*.

1. He didn’t **obtain** good results.
2. He decides to work **harder**.
3. He wants to **improve** his performance.
4. He wants better **marks**.
5. He wants to **go up** to 3eme.
6. If he doesn’t **study** his lessons, he will **fail**.

### Activity 2 – Matching
Match column A with the correct ending in column B.

| Column A | Column B |
|---|---|
| 1. If you don’t work hard, | f. you will fail your exam |
| 2. My brother will pass his BEPC | b. we will pass the BEPC exam next year |
| 3. If Akissi doesn’t improve her results, | e. if they study their lessons |
| 4. The students will obtain good marks | d. if he works harder |
| 5. If we work harder this year, | c. if I go up to 3eme |
| 6. My father will be happy | a. she won’t succeed |

## 4. Communication Activity
- List conditions your friend needs to succeed.
- Tell him what he shouldn’t do.
- Explain advantages of academic success.
- Write what you would do in various future scenarios.

## 5. Assessment
15 multiple‑choice, true/false, and fill‑in‑the‑blank questions to evaluate understanding of conditional structures and related vocabulary.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses a conditional structure with *if*?
options: If Koffi will work harder, he will improve his results.
If Koffi works harder, he will improve his results.
If Koffi worked harder, he will improve his results.
If Koffi working harder, he will improve his results.
questions.explanation: The correct form is *If + present simple → will + base verb*.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: If you don’t ___, you will fail this year.
Choose the correct completion: If Koffi works ___, he will improve his results.
Which word means "to achieve a goal"?
Fill in the blank: He wants to ___ on what he has not learnt.
What does "go up" mean in the school context?

options: You will fail unless you catch up.
You will fail unless you catch uped.
You will fail unless you catch uped.
You will fail unless you catch uped.
questions.explanation: Correct form is *unless you catch up*.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: He wants to ___ the BEPC exam next year.
Which word best completes: He wants to ___ his performance?
Which of the following is NOT a vocabulary word from the lesson?
questions.explanation: Study is a verb, not listed as a vocabulary word.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: If you win 10 million CFA at the national lottery, you will ___?
Which sentence is a conditional with *if*?
options: Unless you study, you will fail.
If you study, you will fail.
If you study, you will succeed.
Unless you study, you will succeed.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: He wants to ___ his aim to pass the exam.
Which of the following best describes a *hardworking student*?
options: A student who studies more intensely
A student who only studies for exams
